Decided to continue this since the other person who was doing it stopped for some reason. I decided to organize the art a bit for convenience so hopefully you guys don’t mind. I also decided to include some fan coloring’s as well since I thought it would be a nice addition, so props to all the people who did them. (Also decided to keep the leave out the uncolored art)

PLEASE READ THIS!!!!
